versions.name: Camp Melakwa

features.note: A variety of aquatic activities on the camp's lake.
Summit attempts on Middle Sister, in the Cascade crest above camp.
Climbing and rappelling on natural rock.
A clear mountain lake at camp.

versions.summary: High-Cascades resident camp set at elevation, offering mountain hiking, COPE, and climbing, plus a waterfront, dining hall, and programming for older Scouts including high-adventure options.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Some codes are retained from the original camp-finder import and were not re-confirmed by this survey.
